sara_net: FYI seeing p99 encode jumps on eu3 hosts starting 23:12UTC. GPU idle, NIC tx queue 5 saturating with tiny packets.
paul_sched: top talkers?
sara_net: flow-agg shows tenant-streamer (47%), tenant-quickbench (18%), infra-repl (15%), misc smalls. Packet sizes tiny, lots of token-by-token RPCs holding TX rings.
mina_sre: any recent scheduler changes or client deploys?
sara_net: no scheduler changes. correlates with an internal replication burst from infra-repl around 23:05UTC. looks like p2p traffic sharing NIC queue with tenant traffic.
chris_ops: could be noisy neighbor at NIC share level. quick mitigation idea: carve an "egress-redistribute" micro-slice across eu3 racks and soft-redirect p2p + the loud tenants there, with per-host eBPF shaping. keep preemptible so cost impact low.
paul_sched: I prefer a soft weight ramp: 10% -> 30% -> 70% with 12m observation windows. Also reduce backfill weight for the slice so we don't thrash allocator.
sara_net: commands to tag and soft-route:
kubectl annotate tenant tenant-streamer routing=egress-redistribute
kubectl annotate tenant tenant-quickbench routing=egress-redistribute
# scheduler api
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://scheduler.internal/api/v1/routes/weights -d '{"slice":"egress-redistribute-eu3","weight":0.1,"region":"eu3"}'
mina_sre: opsbot create incident and set paging if p99>220ms for 10m.
opsbot: Incident created INC-2026-8001 "eu3 egress tx-queue saturation". Paging threshold set.
costbot: Note: if we convert slice to reserved for 24h projected delta ~$1.7k. Preemptible delta much lower.
chris_ops: start soft 10% now, enable eBPF per-host tbf at 8G for shaped slice, collect per-pod tx ring metrics.
sara_net: 23:20UTC update: p99 improved from 480ms -> 300ms with 10% routing; per-host tx ring depth down ~30%.
paul_sched: good signal. ramp to 30% in 10m if stable. if oscillation appears, shard slice across racks rather than single-concentrated slice.
mina_sre: long term: enforce proxy-side pacing per-tenant and scheduler soft-quotas to avoid p2p collisions. file RFC after incident.
sara_net: will write runbook "egress-redistribute soft-redirect" and upload to infra-playbooks. thanks team :thumbsup:
